intro: Starex University, Gurgaon offers B.Pharm in our database opened in {{year}}, with a recorded year tuition and a 2023 placement row. St Andrews Institute of Technology and Management (SAITM), Gurgaon, is the other college named in this article, but it has no B.Pharm programme, fee or placement data on this page.
SAITM vs Starex University for B.Pharm is therefore a one-sided comparison until SAITM's B.Pharm records appear. This page does not invent a missing pharmacy programme.

sections.heading: SAITM vs Starex University for B.Pharm: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: The only college with B.Pharm data on this page is Starex University. Our records list year tuition of ₹75,000 for Bachelor of Pharmacy, and a 2023 row with an average package of ₹3 lakh and a highest package of ₹5 lakh.
SAITM has no B.Pharm programme data on this page. This article does not treat a blank side as a cheaper option, and it does not assume that SAITM currently offers B.Pharm.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Starex University has recorded B.Pharm tuition of ₹75,000 a year. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check the official circular.
There is no B.Pharm fee record here for SAITM, because no pharmacy programme loaded on this comparison.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Starex University's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹3 lakh and a highest package of ₹5 lakh, listed against Bachelor of Pharmacy. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
SAITM has no B.Pharm placement row on this page. Do not use an engineering or other-course package as a substitute.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Starex University has no entrance exam listed for B.Pharm in our records on this page. Pharmacy admissions may use Class 12 science marks or a state / university test. Confirm the official notice.
For SAITM, first confirm on the official admissions page whether B.Pharm is offered in the current year.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Starex University is listed at NH-48, Village Binola, Bhorakalan, Gurgaon.

This page has no usable location data for SAITM on the B.Pharm comparison, because that side did not load. SAITM is listed on a separate engineering comparison in Gurgaon; confirm any campus address from the official site.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a B.Pharm comparison with recorded data, only Starex University can be discussed here, at recorded tuition of ₹75,000 a year and 2023 figures of a ₹3 lakh average and a ₹5 lakh highest package.
This page cannot rank SAITM for B.Pharm, because no programme, fee or placement data is on the page.
Do not invent a missing pharmacy programme or a missing fee.
